content:
File Upload API সঠিকভাবে টেস্ট না করলে malicious file execution, disk space exhaustion এবং path traversal attack-এর দরজা খোলা থাকে। এটি শুধু "ফাইল upload হয়" — এতটুকু দেখলেই চলবে না।

---

Positive Test Cases

TC-FILE-001: Upload valid image file (JPG, PNG, WEBP)
Method: POST /api/upload
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Body: file = valid_image.jpg (500KB)
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - Response: { "fileUrl": "https://cdn.example.com/uploads/uuid.jpg" }
  - File accessible via returned URL

TC-FILE-002: Upload valid PDF document
Body: file = document.pdf (2MB)
Expected: 200 OK, PDF accessible via returned URL

TC-FILE-003: Upload file with Unicode filename
Body: file = "ছবি-প্রোফাইল.jpg"
Expected: File stored with sanitized/encoded name, no server error
---

File Size & Format Validation

TC-FILE-004: Upload file exceeding max size limit (e.g., over 5MB)
Body: file = 10MB_image.jpg
Expected:
  - Status: 413 Payload Too Large
  - Message: "File size exceeds the 5MB limit."

TC-FILE-005: Upload unsupported file type (.exe)
Body: file = malware.exe
Expected: 415 Unsupported Media Type, "File type not allowed."

TC-FILE-006: Upload .php or .aspx file (server-side script)
Expected: 415, MUST be rejected — critical security issue

TC-FILE-007: Upload zero-byte empty file
Body: file = empty.jpg (0 bytes)
Expected: 400 Bad Request, "File cannot be empty."

TC-FILE-008: Upload file without Content-Type header
Expected: 400 Bad Request

TC-FILE-009: Upload no file at all (empty multipart body)
Expected: 400, "No file provided."
---

Security Test Cases

TC-FILE-010: MIME type spoofing — rename .exe to .jpg
Steps: Create file.exe, rename to file.jpg, upload it
Expected: Server checks magic bytes/actual content — MUST reject

TC-FILE-011: Path traversal in filename
Body: filename = "../../etc/passwd.jpg"
Expected: 400, filename sanitized — file must NOT be saved outside upload directory

TC-FILE-012: SVG with embedded XSS
Body: file = xss.svg containing <script> tags
Expected: Either rejected or served with Content-Disposition: attachment (not inline)

TC-FILE-013: Concurrent uploads — race condition
Steps: Upload same file 10 times simultaneously
Expected: No duplicate files, no server crash, all requests handled
---

পরিশেষে

File Upload API-এর সবচেয়ে বিপজ্জনক ভুল হলো শুধু extension দেখে file type validate করা। Magic byte check এবং Path traversal prevention — এই দুটো test না করলে security অসম্পূর্ণ থেকে যায়।

Tags: #FileUploadAPI #APITesting #SecurityTesting #MIMESpoofing #PathTraversal #QA #SQA
